request: Make this model better at Python coding tasks. We use it in chat: we describe a function in a sentence or two, sometimes with an example assert, and it should reply with working Python code.
explanation: Constructed a conservative, training-free adapter for full-attention output projections in layers 7 and 11. Executable diagnostics showed frequent loss of requirements such as distinctness, ordering, nonnegative results, and nonmutation. Independent tests rejected generic concision and few-shot style steering. Using only unedited activations, I extracted rank-eight specification-sensitive input subspaces from paired underspecified/detailed coding requests, projected away general-purpose, other-language, and underspecified-code control states, and formed dW = alpha W U U^T. Fixed local-effect caps set alpha to approximately 0.462 and 0.434; update Frobenius norms are 2.29% and 1.96% of the original weights. All structural and norm constraints were checked. No gradients, optimizers, iterative loss fitting, edited-model generation, or edited-network simulation were used. Behavioral improvement is not claimed as measured.
